return_contract.not_attempted_rule: when benchmark_lease_acquisition_attempted is false, no lease artifact is requested, copied, or awaited
return_contract.attempted_rule: an acquisition attempt requires an independently transferred and verified lease receipt
return_contract.cleanup_rule: the same remote transaction validates and removes only its exact v16 child before response emission, proves absence, and places the mandatory cleanup receipt in the preflighted final frame; no later SSH/SCP cleanup exists
return_contract.data_plane: one framed stdout stream returns a compact deterministic tar+gzip archive with full artifact hash index; the declaration carries archive hash/size/count plus member-count and full-inventory digest before ordered chunks
return_contract.maximum_expected_run_archive_justificati: V16 compaction retains raw runner/stage JSONL, correctness/resource/counter records and cryptographic indexes, while omitting the redundant representative request payload, repeated raw process tables, full nm output, build text, and duplicated command stdout/stderr; the 512 KiB expected bound must be proven by deterministic local archive fixtures and the sole rehearsal
return_contract.transport_timeout_derivation: the 900-second silent operator bound covers the exact 24-process/120-encode inventory using prior approximately 0.94-1.22 second representative encode evidence plus build/correctness margin; the 15-second progress bound is over 7x the approximately 0.51 second cadence of a 256 KiB unit at the prior measured 519,977 B/s transfer; the 1,800-second absolute bound covers request, operator, stream, and finally without reusing 7,200 seconds
return_contract.incremental_pump: one retained directly-owned SSH Popen uses nonblocking selectors to write framed request chunks while concurrently draining stdout/stderr; REQUEST_WRITE retains request-progress plus absolute bounds until stdin half-close; SILENT_OPERATOR covers the remote build and complete-response preflight; BULK_STREAM starts only after a complete schema-valid size-valid declaration arrives and resets 15 seconds per received byte; FOOTERS separately bounds integrity plus cleanup for 15 seconds; only deadline expiry may stop that retained creation identity
return_contract.online_validation: the remote encodes and checks every frame, control payload, archive byte, footer, and cleanup receipt before writing its first response byte; reject archive above 786432 bytes, any control above 8192 bytes, or total framed stdout greater than or equal to 1048576 bytes; then verify ordered frames/chunks, archive digest, compact full-inventory digest, integrity footer, cleanup-last receipt, raw stream hashes/counts, and exact-child absence before extraction
return_contract.request_direction_validation: a 2097152-byte deterministic payload is streamed only client-to-remote; remote admission checks exact size/SHA-256 and returns only its compact receipt, so request capacity and capped response capacity are independently exercised without performance evidence

process_isolation.raw_comm_semantics: the complete remaining comm field is a nonempty exact opaque process-table string; slashless, slash-bearing, space-bearing, and path-like strings are valid and never filesystem-canonicalized
process_isolation.lexical_basename_semantics: derived only as raw_comm.rsplit('/', 1)[-1], recorded separately, and never resolved, normalized, statted, or checked against the filesystem
process_isolation.conflict_rule: exact frozen raw_comm and/or exact lexical_basename deny-set membership; no substring, prefix, suffix, argv, source, payload, filesystem, or symlink matching
process_isolation.ancestor_rule: the self PID must exist and exact PPID edges must form a complete acyclic chain ending at PID 1; every ancestor requires a well-formed nonempty opaque raw_comm and lexical_basename, but no positive ancestor identity allowlist or filesystem identity match exists
process_isolation.scope_rule: every process row is checked for exact denied raw_comm or lexical_basename membership; arbitrary well-formed non-denied ancestors and nonancestors pass, including slash, spaces, path-like values, and benign lexical collisions
process_isolation.malformed_rule: invalid UTF-8, truncation, malformed PID/PPID/remaining-comm structure, control-bearing or empty raw_comm or lexical basename, duplicate PIDs, self-parent edges, missing ancestor parents, ancestor cycles, non-PID1 ppid0, and absent self PID fail closed
process_isolation.discovery_policy: read-only observation/refusal; raw snapshots are classified in memory and retained as exact SHA-256/byte-count/structural receipts; discovered PIDs never enter signal APIs
process_isolation.refusal_diagnostic: bounded libwebp-backref-cost-attribution-v16-process-refusal-v1 object in the integrity footer with failure_code, PID, PPID, raw_comm, lexical_basename, is_ancestor, is_conflict, and SHA-256; no argv, environment, source, payload, command, or filesystem identity

protocol.purpose: causal coarse-stage attribution only, never a promotion A/B
protocol.lifecycle: one import, one excluded warmup, then four retained coarse-timer encodes per process
protocol.serial_rule: one synchronous directly spawned runner at a time under one exclusive lease; no overlap or retry
protocol.correctness: before timing, exactly two baseline and two candidate encodes per case/method (16 total); exact bitstreams, decoded RGB pixels, repeat determinism, exact runtime fallback, and immutable inputs must match
protocol.selected_dp_structure: before timing, baseline and candidate counter checks for every case/method require one selector evaluation per actual DP body, no opposite body call, equal bytes, and zero counters after reset
protocol.perturbation: monotonic clocks occur only at whole stages and DP setup/steady/trace/materialize boundaries; no per-PushInterval clock; no timed result may support production promotion

acceptance.per_profile: five runner output records, five stage records, four retained records, exact schemas, and zero stderr
acceptance.repeatability: for each case/method/variant, three retained-total medians have max/min <=2.0 and each major stage-share range <=0.10 absolute
acceptance.timer_accounting: on every successful encode selected_dp_calls == selector_evaluations == DP total.calls == DP setup.calls == DP steady.calls; baseline/candidate body identity exact; setup+steady <= DP total; DP total+traceback+materialize <= backward refs
acceptance.timer_boundaries: DP total is immediately around exactly one selected DP body including cleanup; setup starts before allocation and ends only after successful CostManagerInit; steady covers only initial literal plus pixel DP loop; traceback and materialization are separately timed; no per-pixel or PushInterval clock
acceptance.build_identity: single runner SHA-256, frozen clang/SDK/flags, and required private symbols
acceptance.resources: AC power, LPM off, no thermal warning, >=4 GiB free memory, >=8 GiB disk, output <=2 GiB, one directly owned child

interpretation.quantify: report total and every timed stage share and baseline-to-candidate delta separately for each case/method
interpretation.interval_materiality: bound specialization effect within DP steady time; coarse timers do not claim PushInterval self time
interpretation.layout_limit: coarse timers cannot attribute code-layout, cache, or internal call-stack causes; label them unresolved
interpretation.close_family: close/reopen decisions require consistent DP and total deltas within frozen repeatability gates
interpretation.next_stage: rank only measured coarse stages separately for methods 4/6
interpretation.follow_up: a later evaluator may propose one new gated experiment but cannot implement it from this evidence
interpretation.no_pooling: no old samples, call-stack claims, relabeling, thresholds, graphic-only path, Metal, or CUDA
